input.name: Nightshift
input.idea: A planned shift-handoff board for independent warehouse teams. Supervisors would leave unresolved tasks, equipment notes and shift priorities for the next crew. No inventory integrations, predictive AI or live tracking are promised.

research.competitors: Role-based access is common in other tools.

brief.problem: Unresolved tasks and equipment notes need a clear shift handoff.
brief.promise: A planned handoff board for the incoming warehouse crew.
proof_points: Leave unresolved tasks for your next crew.
Keep equipment notes with your handoff.
Share your shift priorities on the same board.
brief.concept_disclosure: Join the waitlist for early-access updates.

direction.illustration_style: Warm botanical line work using the same ink and ochre palette.
direction.section_rhythm: An open introduction followed by a planting diagram and a warm invitation.
